title: Math Mentor learning-state event
description: Structural contract for one append-only learning event. Four layers are distinct: structural validity (this schema), transition legality (reduce_readonly.py), semantic sufficiency (evidence requirements), and Human authority (a procedural gate no schema can express). Passing this schema does not make a transition legal and does not grant authority. Events live in the learner-bound local store, never in the repository. Version 2 followed the 2026-07-19 independent review.

event_id.description: Unique within a store; duplicates are rejected by the reducer.

event_type.description: 'correction' is NOT supported in v2. A replay-safe compensation model must be specified in the contract before it is re-enabled; leaving a half-working correction path was a defect found by independent review.

review_window_id.description: Identifies one review window. Required when entering review_due; must be distinct from every window already counted for the node, and a pass must cite the window that is currently pending.

review_window_kind.description: Typed review window. Graduation requires BOTH kinds, so two arbitrary window ids of the same kind cannot satisfy the minimum.

remediation_evidence.description: Required for stale -> review_due. Decay alone does not re-qualify a node for review.

blocker_resolution_evidence.description: Required when leaving blocked; the reducer also enforces Human-only unblocking and returning to the recorded prior status.

blocker_evidence.description: Required for any transition into blocked. A bare block event would lose why and from where.

review_failure_evidence.description: Required only for review_due -> stale with cause review_failed. A summary string alone is not evidence that an attempt happened and went badly.

stale_evidence.description: Required for any transition into stale. Causes are not interchangeable: an expired window was never attempted, a failed review was.

classroom_evidence.description: Required for a transition into classroom_passed. If present it must be complete: a partial bundle is not evidence.

exam_agent_result.description: Only a pass is persistable. `failed` and `needs_reprep` remain valid Exam outcomes in the session contract, but no learning-state transition consumes them, so they are unsupported_pending_contract here and cannot enter the event store.

review_evidence.description: Required for a transition into review_passed. If present it must be complete.

student_ref.description: Privacy-safe alias or hash only. Real identity is forbidden by STUDENT_LEARNING_STATE_SCHEMA.md section 2.

source_ref.description: Required and non-null: an event with no citable source is not evidence.

actually_read_files.description: Self-declared and non-verifiable; never upstream evidence in a correctness chain (TEACHING_AGENT_CONTRACTS.md section 2).

evidence_timestamp.description: RFC 3339 with a timezone offset. The pattern is enforced explicitly because `format: date-time` is a no-op unless an optional format library is installed, and a silently skipped check is worse than none.

learning_state_epoch.description: Must equal the bound epoch in epoch.yml; mismatched events are ignored by the reducer.

human_authorization_ref.description: Records that a Human acted. It is NOT identity proof and a non-empty string is not authority; graduation remains a procedural gate that this package will not persist autonomously.

prev_event_digest.description: SHA-256 of the previous event file, forming the integrity chain that replaces Git immutability in the local store.

allOf.$comment: Evidence bundles are transition-specific. An ignored bundle must never enter the append-only log, because a later reader cannot tell whether it was honoured.
review_failure_evidence belongs only to a failed review attempt.
Window identity is declared when a window is opened, not carried around afterwards.
Resolution evidence belongs only to a proposed unblock.
